command: async (page) => await page.evaluate(async()=>{ const s=await (await fetch("/api/state")).json(); const r=await (await fetch("/api/roster/team_nexus")).json(); return {state:s,roster:r.players.map(x=>({id:x.id,stamina:x.stamina,dev_focus:x.dev_focus,training_intensity:x.training_intensity})),development:r.development_report,dom:document.body.innerText.slice(0,1800)}; })
